title: Logic's Built-in Plugins
intro: The stock plugins worth knowing properly, and the specific controls that make each one worth reaching for.

tips.t: Compressor — use the side‑chain filter before reaching for a multiband
tips.d: Turn on the side-chain filter, set it to HP and sweep the frequency up until the kick stops triggering most of the gain reduction. Click Listen to hear what the detector hears. Switch Listen off again before you judge the mix.

src.label: Apple — Compressor side chain parameters in Logic Pro for Mac
Sound On Sound — Logic: Compression Sessions
MusicTech — Advanced Use Of The Logic Compressor

tips.t: Multipressor — use it to control one problem band only
tips.d: Bypass every band except the one you need. It becomes a dynamic EQ rather than a mix‑flattening machine.

src.label: Apple — Multipressor in Logic Pro for Mac
Apple — Multipressor frequency band controls in Logic Pro for Mac (MY)

tips.t: Noise Gate — use the side chain to key one sound from another
tips.d: Gate a white noise layer from the snare's signal and you have an instant layered snare that follows the performance.

src.label: Apple — Use Noise Gate in Logic Pro for Mac

tips.t: Enveloper — reshape a transient without a compressor
tips.d: The two Gain sliders either side of the display boost or cut the attack and release phases of any sound. Push Attack up to add snap to a soft kick. Pull it down and percussive sounds fade in more softly.

src.label: Apple — Enveloper in Logic Pro for Mac

tips.t: Channel EQ — turn on Analyzer and set it to Post
tips.d: Seeing what you are cutting is worth more than any preset. Post‑EQ analysis shows the result rather than the source.

src.label: Apple — Channel EQ parameters in Logic Pro for Mac

tips.t: Match EQ — steal a tone rather than guess at it
tips.d: Learn a reference, learn your track, and Match EQ builds a filter curve from the difference. The Apply slider sets how hard that curve hits: under 100% reduces it, over 100% exaggerates it, and negative values invert its peaks and troughs. Raise Smoothing to even out a spiky curve.

src.label: Apple — Match EQ parameters in Logic Pro for Mac
Apple — Match EQ parameters in Logic Pro for Mac (MY)
Apple — Use Match EQ in Logic Pro for Mac

tips.t: ChromaVerb — use the Damping display as the main control
tips.d: The Damping EQ overlaid on the main display sets how much of each frequency stays in the reverb decay. Drag the high shelving dot down to shorten the high-end decay and the tail gets darker.

src.label: Apple — ChromaVerb display and Damping EQ in Logic Pro for Mac

tips.t: Delay Designer — build rhythmic patterns, not echoes
tips.d: Each tap has its own delay time plus independent filter cutoff and resonance, transpose, pan and level. Treat it as a sequencer for delay taps and build patterns rather than plain echoes.

src.label: Apple — Delay Designer Tap parameter bar in Logic Pro for Mac

tips.t: Stereo Delay — set different times per side
tips.d: Turn off Stereo Link, then set 1/8 on the left and dotted 1/8 on the right, so each side repeats at its own time.

src.label: Apple — Stereo Delay in Logic Pro for Mac

tips.t: Tape Delay — turn up Flutter for analogue character
tips.d: Flutter Rate and Intensity simulate the speed irregularities of an analogue tape transport, and the LFO adds further delay modulation. The Low and High Cut filters sit in the feedback path, so each repeat gets thinner or darker than the last.

src.label: Apple — Tape Delay in Logic Pro for Mac

tips.t: Phat FX — one plugin, an entire character chain
tips.d: Six effects modules in one window — Band-pass, Distortion, Mod FX, Bass Enhancer, Compressor and Filter — plus an assignable X/Y pad, three modulation sources (Env Follower, LFO 1, LFO 2) and an Effect Order strip. Distortion types include Bitcrusher, Diode, Dirt, Downsampler, Grit, Scream, Soft Saturation and Vari Drive.

src.label: Apple — Phat FX overview in Logic Pro for Mac
Apple — Phat FX processors in Logic Pro for Mac

tips.t: Remix FX — perform DJ effects live
tips.d: Real-time effects including Gater, Downsampler, Reverse and Tape Stop, played from buttons, sliders and XY pads. Apple built it for real-time effects common to electronic and dance music.

src.label: Apple — Remix FX in Logic Pro for Mac

tips.t: Gain — use it to check phase, not just level
tips.d: The Gain plugin's Phase Invert button gives you a quick phase check. Flip it, listen for the low end, keep whichever is bigger.

src.label: Apple — Gain controls in Logic Pro for Mac

tips.t: Test Oscillator — reference tones for calibration
tips.d: Generates sine and square waves at an adjustable frequency (1 kHz by default), plus white and pink noise, for use as reference tones.

src.label: Apple — Test Oscillator in Logic Pro for Mac
